title: JACO repository audit — sixteen local, independent senior-specialist review tasks
claim: Assignments execute only on explicit --audit-repo --run through the local Gemma API. They are sequential LLM calls, not autonomous GitHub writers or concurrent worker processes. Every claim needs human/reproducible evidence.

missions.assignment: Rita komponentgränserna och identifiera duplicerat runtime-ansvar, oavsiktliga sidoberoenden samt en enda konkret korrigering.
missions.required_output: Decision: BUG_CONFIRMED / NEEDS_EVIDENCE / NO_ISSUE_SEEN. Quote a concrete, visible source line number and exact failure condition. Include one minimal test to falsify the claim. Avoid running commands or claiming a fix was implemented.
